Smithsonian Secretary Lonnie Bunch to Retire Amid Controversy

Lonnie G. Bunch III, Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution, is retiring. The announcement comes amid allegations of "far-left woke messaging" within the museums. Bunch has led the institution since 2019. The specific reasons for his departure beyond the allegations were not detailed in the coverage.
